title: RidgeBank audit evidence collation and workshop notes
summary: Working packet collating answers to RidgeBank's infosec questionnaire, evidence artifacts gathered for a Dedicated POC, and notes from the 2025-06-05 technical-security workshop. This is an iterative draft for internal review before sending the official evidence bundle to RidgeBank security.
questionnaire_overview: RidgeBank provided a 120-question security questionnaire focused on data residency, cryptography, access controls, logging, and third-party risk. We've provisionally answered 98 questions; 22 require attachments or vendor attestations (HSM, SOC2 audit report, KMS key policy). Responses use Redwood standard language where applicable and include explicit callouts where Dedicated/Private deployment differences change posture.
evidence_index: network-segmentation-diagram.png — VPC subnets, private endpoints, no public inference endpoints
kms-key-policy-sample.txt — example customer KMS policy for per-tenant encryption
hsm-attestation-summary.pdf — vendor statement and tamper-evident control checklist (redacted)
sro-latency-and-retry-matrix.csv — SRE-run tests showing SLO attainment under 95th percentile load
audit-logs-sample.json — example audit log events (session start, model-pull, key-access) with pseudonymized IDs
third-party-supplier-matrix.xlsx — list of vendors, contract statuses, and controls mapping
penetration-test-exec-summary.pdf — internal pen test focused on management plane from 2025-02
responses_highlights: Key answers emphasized: (1) Customer data can be isolated using Dedicated pools or Private deployments with customer-managed VPCs; (2) KMS integration supports customer-managed keys and HSM-backed KMS for FIPS requirements; (3) Audit logs are immutable and exportable to customer SIEMs; (4) Model artifacts are versioned and signed; (5) Fallback policies documented for cross-region failover.
outstanding_risks: Need formal HSM attestation for vendor used in Private offering — vendor executing SOC2+FIPS attestation in Q3
RidgeBank requested explicit data deletion proof-of-process for ephemeral caches — we have ops runbook but need sample run logs
Network reachability question for legacy on-prem connector — requires runbook and one-time test with RidgeBank network team
Request for longer key-rotation windows to match RidgeBank policy — need legal approval for contract amendment
workshop_notes: 2025-06-05 technical workshop with RidgeBank security and platform teams (attendees: Aisha K., Marcus L., RidgeBank: J. Patel, S. Nguyen)
Agenda covered: architecture walkthrough, KMS/HSM options, audit log pipeline, model provenance, and canary rollback strategy
Actionable discussion: RidgeBank prefers HSM-backed KMS; Redwood to surface vendor SLA and attestation timeline
Security asked for live demo of private control plane UI showing tenant isolation and log export — scheduled for 2025-06-12
Concern raised about KV cache persistence on Dedicated nodes; clarified that caches are ephemeral, TTL-based, and can be disabled per-route
